name.description: The extension's name, Kando's name in this language.

description.message: Add videos to Kando from the pages of video sites.
description.description: The extension's description in the browser's list of extensions.

buttonAdd.description: Button in a video's page while Kando is not running, the same words as Kando's Download Video in its browser.

buttonQueued.description: Button in a video's page for a video in Kando's queue, while Kando is not running.

buttonDone.description: Button in a video's page for a video in Kando's library, while Kando is not running.

menuAdd.description: Item of the menu on a link to a video.

popupAdd.description: Button of the toolbar popup that adds the tab's video to Kando.

popupShow.description: Button of the toolbar popup that shows the tab's video in Kando.

popupNoVideo.message: Open a video’s page to add it to Kando.
popupNoVideo.description: Line of the toolbar popup on a page that is not a video's.

popupConnect.message: Connect Kando to this browser in Kando’s Settings › General › Browser Extension.
popupConnect.description: Line of the toolbar popup when the browser cannot reach Kando: where in Kando to connect it.
